rulings.why: Wrong word for 'another', let pass; low because it was self-talk.

challenges.why: The 'الـ--' at 12:45 is a stutter-restart (S5); her 'لا، أول الكلمة' follows her English 'To the beginning of it' and he fixed it to 'لأول الـ-- في أول الكلمة' - the missing piece is the preposition (لـ / في), not an el- / idafa (A2) slip. Label likely wrong.
